question.text: A particle of mass ' $m$ ' is projected with a velocity $v$ making an angle of $30^{\circ}$ with the horizontal. The magnitude of angular momentum of the projectile about the point of projection when the particle is at its maximum height ' $h$ ' is

solution.text:
Angular momentum $L_{0}=p r_{\perp}$ $\left(\because\right.$ linear momentum $p=m v \cos \theta$ and $\left.\mathrm{r}_{1}=H\right)$
$\Rightarrow L_{0}=m v \cos \theta H$ $=m v \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{v^{2} \sin ^{2} 30^{\circ}}{2 g}$ $=\frac{\sqrt{3} m v^{3}}{16 g}$
